mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising new housing starts above 2000 thousand units for three consecutive months indicates a housing market expansion that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST rising for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment over the prior 6 months indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS increasing for 6 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO < 100 for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, rising interest rates compress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payroll employment signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE declining and PAYEMS increasing, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
